label: Figure 6.2: A perfectly elastic supply curve (PES = infinity)
alt: A horizontal supply curve at price P1: any quantity is supplied at P1 and none below it, so PES is infinite.
caption: A perfectly elastic supply curve is horizontal at P<sub>1</sub>. Producers will supply any quantity at that price but nothing at all below it, so quantity supplied responds infinitely to a price change and PES = ∞.
